o1: Predicted to enable cytokine activity and transforming growth factor beta receptor binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cellular response to cGMP; regulation of gene expression; response to bacterium; and dauer larval development. Is located in extracellular space. Is expressed in coelomocyte; neurons; pharynx; and in male. Is part of TGF-β receptor signaling pathway. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in myostatin-related muscle hypertrophy and vertebral hypersegmentation and orofacial anomalies. Orthologous to several human genes including GDF11.
